title: Gaming cafe license in India: registrations you need
description: Which registrations and licences a gaming cafe in India usually needs: business registration, Shop and Establishment, GST, trade licence and fire safety.

body.text: There is no single "gaming cafe licence" in India. Instead, a gaming cafe needs the same set of registrations as most small businesses, plus a few local permissions that vary by state and city. Here is what most cafes need, and how to check the local rules where you are opening.
Choose a structure: sole proprietorship, partnership, LLP or private limited company. A sole proprietorship is the simplest to start; an LLP or company is common when there are partners or investors.

Almost every state requires commercial premises to register under its Shop and Establishment Act, usually within a short period of opening. It covers working hours, holidays and staff conditions, and it is often the first document a bank asks for when you open a current account.

You need GST registration once your turnover crosses the threshold for your state, and many cafes register earlier to claim input tax credit on equipment. Check the current threshold and rate for your services with a chartered accountant.
Most municipal corporations require a trade licence for businesses operating in their area. Apply to your local municipal office; the fee and documents depend on the city.
5. Fire safety and other local permissions

Depending on the size of the premises and local rules, you may need a fire safety certificate or NOC. Some cities and states also have rules on amusement or entertainment businesses, minimum ages or opening hours, so ask your municipal office and local police station what applies to a gaming cafe in your area.
Use genuine copies of Windows and games, and check the publisher's terms for commercial use. Many PC games and launchers have specific rules or programmes for internet and gaming cafes.

The Hash [gaming cafe cost calculator](/gaming-cafe-cost-calculator) includes about ₹30,000 for licences and registration as a starting estimate; actual costs depend on your city and the professionals you hire. Start the paperwork as soon as you sign the lease, because some approvals take weeks.
Planning the rest of your cafe? See our [step-by-step checklist for starting a gaming cafe](/blog/how-to-start-gaming-cafe-india-checklist). This article is general information, not legal advice.
